schema.description: Send exactly one of `quantity` (eaches, drawn from loose stock) or `cases` (whole sealed cases, ADR 0045); sending both is 400 `quantity-and-cases-exclusive`, sending neither is 422 `zero-quantity`.

quantity.description: Eaches to reserve from loose stock. A positive integer; mutually exclusive with `cases`.

cases.description: Whole sealed cases to reserve (ReserveFullCases, ADR 0045), oldest stowed container first. The reservation quantity is the cases' eaches (cases x unitsPerPack). Mutually exclusive with `quantity`. A sealed case is never split by a `quantity` reservation.

ownerRef.description: Whose stock the reservation draws on (ADR 0045). A reservation never spans owners. Omitted means fleet-owned stock only, never "any owner": a seller's stock cannot satisfy it. A malformed value is 400 `invalid-owner-ref`.

demandRef.description: Caller-supplied reference identifying the demand this reservation satisfies (e.g. an order id).

lineNo.description: Optional order line this reservation is for (ADR 0036). When sent it is stored on the reservation and returned as `lineNo`, and it lets the TaskCompleted consumer confirm exactly the picked line instead of counting picks (ADR 0035). Omit it, or send null, when unknown. Valid range is 1 to 2147483647 (a 32-bit integer); 0, negative values and values above 2147483647 are rejected with 400 `invalid-line-no`. Because it is part of the request body, adding it to a request whose Idempotency-Key was first used WITHOUT it is a different body (422 `idempotency-key-reused`).

schema.title: ReserveStockRequest
